name: Dotsky
summary: A small-business money app where every payment is a dot on one night-sky chart
about: A money app for a small business that shows every payment of the past year as a dot: money in rises above the line, money out falls below, and bigger payments are bigger stars. Drag across the sky to add up any window, switch the range to watch the dots glide, and see repeating payments joined like dotskytions. Around it sit payments, accounts with transfers and a card, budgets, repeating costs, contacts and plain-English insights.
how: Watch the dots fly out from the centre line, then hover one for details or click it to edit
Drag across the sky to select a window and read its totals on the right
Switch 30D, 90D and 12M to see every dot glide to its new place
Turn categories on and off, or type a name to highlight its dots
Add or delete payments and watch the sky and totals update
Move money between accounts with a confirm step, freeze the card and edit budgets
